messages:
deploy-bot: Automated alert -> spike in control-plane egress failures in eu-west-1 at 2007890123. Impact: private deployments intermittently fail to connect (502/timeout). Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-7810 :rotating_light:

tariq (oncall): seeing `tls: unexpected msg` and `connection refused` in transit-proxy logs. Correlates with firewall policy rollout 2007890000.

megan: looks like provider pushed an auto-block list that included our egress IP range. Provider ticket opened.

aaron: immediate mitigation: add explicit allow rule at transit layer and restart proxies in rolling fashion. Doing first region batch now. ETA ~12m.

support_ops: composing customer note: "We're investigating intermittent connection failures for private deployments in eu-west-1. Engineers are deploying an emergency allowlist; updates at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-7810."

tariq (oncall): transit allowlist applied at 2007890240, rolling restarts started.

deploy-bot: metric update -> control-plane success rate eu-west-1: 48% -> 94% within 6m after mitigation.

megan: provider confirms auto-block expansion; requested permanent removal and explanation (SR-90012). Follow-ups: add explicit IaC allowlist for control-plane CIDRs, add infra e2e to catch provider auto-blocks, and add alert when control-plane success <90% for 5m.

aaron: customer comms sent at 2007890310 to impacted accounts.

support_ops: two tenants still see reconnect loops; escalated to solutions-eng.

megan: RCA owner assigned. Keep incident open until RCA posted and allowlist validated for 24h. infra-bot marking as mitigated (partial).
